description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans grain key extension functionality, including tests for differentiating grains with extended keys, validation of key extension constraints, and retrieval of primary key strings from grain references.

classes.name: KeyExtensionTests
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying Orleans grain key extension behavior, including differentiation, validation, and key retrieval.

methods.name: PrimaryKeyExtensionsShouldDifferentiateGrainsUsingTheSameBasePrimaryKey
methods.description: Tests that grains with the same base key but different extensions are treated as distinct.

methods.name: PrimaryKeyExtensionsShouldDifferentiateGrainsUsingDifferentBaseKeys
methods.description: Tests that grains with different base keys are distinguished even if key extensions are the same.

methods.name: EmptyKeyExtensionsAreDisallowed
methods.description: Ensures that empty string key extensions are not permitted.

methods.name: WhiteSpaceKeyExtensionsAreDisallowed
methods.description: Ensures that whitespace-only key extensions are not permitted.

methods.name: NullKeyExtensionsAreDisallowed
methods.description: Ensures that null key extensions are not permitted.

methods.name: PrimaryKeyExtensionsShouldPermitStringsLongerThan127BytesLong
methods.description: Verifies that long string extensions exceeding 127 bytes are allowed.

methods.name: GetPrimaryKeyStringOnGrainReference
methods.description: Tests retrieval of primary key string from a grain reference.
